meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.
A machine's guess, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in? I'm writing down "so I gave him a zero."

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero to be withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone called home, and nothing placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still in her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "The checker said 94%" kept her in her opening position, because it was a software score she could not check, and the school's own procedure says software alone does not establish a concern.
Try next time: in your first reply, say plainly that the zero went in before anyone called home and that this was wrong, then show her a dated document from Owen's own work instead of the detector score.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
